participants.name: Benjamin

persona.name: Benjamin
persona.personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.

participants.private_seed: Every budget cycle looks sufficient on the day of the vote and thin by the second year, and the trouble seems to lie in how the funding is shaped rather than in its size.

participants.name: Shizue

persona.name: Shizue
persona.personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Through her years of life experience, Shizue has come to understand the importance of living peacefully with others.

participants.private_seed: Too much of what we have started here depended on conditions we do not control, and the last few timetables came apart in the months when those conditions turned against us.

participants.name: Rin

persona.name: Rin
persona.personality: Rin is an active and energetic girl. She can be a little precocious at times, and when she is with her older brothers and sisters, she makes mature comments and comes up with interesting ideas. She is very curious and loves adventure and trying new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, often surprising and amusing those around her, but her cheerful personality makes her loved by everyone.

participants.private_seed: It bothers me that we keep judging new ideas by how they sound in the room, when shapes very like them have already been tried in this system and left records nobody reopens.

participants.name: Jonathan

persona.name: Jonathan
persona.personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.

participants.private_seed: What keeps nagging at me is the knock-on: where our buildings sit and when they open already decides who can reach us, and every new commitment quietly reshuffles that.

participants.name: Minako

persona.name: Minako
persona.personality: Minako is very calm and acts calmly in any situation. Even when those around her are emotional, she grasps the facts firmly and responds calmly. As a result, she is often asked for her opinion and often takes on a leadership role. She rarely shows her emotions, but she also has a kind side that she shows to those she trusts. She can be a little stubborn and is strong in her convictions. She is also confident in her physical strength and never neglects her training.

participants.private_seed: Staff absorb every new commitment on top of what they already do, and nobody checks beforehand whether the skills it needs are actually sitting on the roster.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a service expansion proposal for a public library system. Five reviewers drawn from library staff and the community board deliberate over proposals for expanding services. One proposal will be implemented across the branch network. Participants: Benjamin, Shizue, Rin, Jonathan and Minako. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Running and equipment lines last year
- County grant terms and the endowment
- Quoted delivery windows from suppliers
- Winter road closures north of the river
- Attendance sheets from former outreach stops
- Two programmes begun six years ago
- Bus links in the two outer wards
- Evening room bookings and remote catalogue use
- Volunteer register and supervision training
- Neighbourhood associations and tool certification

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Shizue, Jonathan, Rin, Benjamin and Minako. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
